content.text: The following is the testing results for migration utils:
1. no-content error: some data stream has no content in the original data store, I prefer the program log the error, and skip the data stream. But now, it just stopped there.
2.  fails on production data which has two more layers (year, MMDD): NullPointerException, details as following

Seems like it's a problem with the idresolver.
We can either fix the id resolver or add a new one that works for your directory structure.
First, pull down the latest version of migration-utils (I just pushed a change) and run the program again.  You should get a better error message.
Second, look in the datastream directory and let me know what some of the filenames look like (when you get down to the files).
Third... there's a slim chance you have a cache problem... delete whatever directory your idresolver is using for its cache and try again. (in the indexRoot) bean.
: I have attached the output log file above. The datastreamStore is organized as following:
2. second level – DDMM (date), for example, under 2005, it has 0930, 1014, 1102...
3. third level and fourth level – two level hash directories, for example 09/49,...
4. under the four levels , there are the actual datastream, for example ~datastreams/2015/0316/09/49/iudl_1897784+ITEM-METADATA+ITEM-METADATA.
I tried to clean the cache, it didn't help.

3. Fails on development data which doesn't have the year and MMDD layers : redirect link error. For one object, the redirect link datastream actually migrated with no error. But the second object failed, but the redirect link actually works. Error info is as following:

4. Policy datastream migration: no error showing when migrating the data, but there is no content migrated.

5. I would like to test the migration for the objects with methods. It didn't go that far since it failed for other datastreams like the redirect purl links. It would be great the program can provide a function for user to skip some number of objects for migration, so that we don't need re-migrate from beginning every time.
Did you make tickets for these identified issues, or should I?  If you did, could you add the label "fedora3-to-4-migration"?
Please document what you have in this ticket as a new child page of:
Use migration-utils with different types of relationships between objects and datastream.  Document results, fails (if there is), and the data not appeared but expected.
